description.text: Enrollment Scope and Object: high school graduates, bachelors/ masters/ PhD degree holders Training Objectives: The training objectives are to integrate the advantages of training resources with Qingdao University, Ocean University of China and other institutions of higher learning, including the establishment of various types of business management and skills training forum to put forward forward-looking and innovative strategic proposals to meet the special needs of the development of enterprises. We will facilitate students and graduates at home and abroad to cultivate the basic qualities of entrepreneurship and pioneering personality, cultivate entrepreneurial awareness, innovative spirit, to acquire a solid foundation in English and have pioneering and innovative ability, business operations and decision-making ability of complex talents. Course subjects: E-commerce, Business Management, Business English, and all kinds of practical activities courses Training time: 16-20 lessons per week, 40 minutes for each lesson

duration.text: The Innovation and Entrepreneurship Training Program at Belt and Road Collaborative Innovation College is a 1 Year long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 5361 USD/per year ￥ 38600 CNY/per year
